notes.title: Re:Call >⩊
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve just rolled out an important update for [i]Re:Call[/i]!
All existing translations (Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese-Brazilian, and English) have been revised and polished for greater accuracy and consistency.[/p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45688190/fa840caa2d80cb28414fc2b2641d4010a8e108c5.png"][/img]

[p]A big highlight is the [b]official addition of Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR)[/b] to the game! From now on, Brazilian players can experience the story in their own language with care and authenticity.[/p]

[p]We also have good news: the price of [i]Re:Call[/i] has been [b]reduced[/b], making it easier than ever to dive into the experience.[/p]

[p]This update not only improves the localization quality but also brings us closer to our global community. We want every player to feel fully immersed, no matter where they are.[/p]

[p]If you haven’t tried [i]Re:Call[/i] yet, now is the perfect moment!
👉 Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist and share your thoughts with us.[/p]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3855000/ReCall/

notes.title: Uncover the Hidden Layers of Every Character
notes.notes:
[p]In Re:Call, no one is exactly who they appear to be. Every character holds quiet stories, subtle gestures, and fragments of themselves that only reveal their truth to those who take the time to truly see.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45688190/2fe6da80402568de1a07d5205e4c063fdaf1e6ee.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]People don’t say everything.  
They hesitate. They deflect. They forget on purpose.[/p][p]Objects hold memories.  
Routines hide patterns.  
The truth slips between moments.[/p][p]You are not solving a mystery  
You are paying attention[/p][p]
[/p][p][u][b]If this resonates with you, add Re:Call to your wishlist[/b][/u][/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3855000/ReCall"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Loop You Never Noticed
notes.notes: [p]Think about it for a moment. How many times have you walked down the same street, talked to the same people and never really seen them? Our minds are vast libraries, and sometimes the most important books are filed away in drawers we’ve forgotten how to open.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45688190/82775769c5add309fd934d9ebcf9d70f8e7e0f53.png"][/img][/p][p]Re:Call isn’t just a visual novel. It’s a quiet reflection on the invisible loops that shape our lives. Every morning, Kaito Nakamura wakes up believing it’s just another ordinary day. But what if it’s not? What if he’s been living the same day again and again, and his mind has simply learned to protect him from the truth?[/p][p]Imagine waking up and realizing that everything feels familiar : not in a nostalgic way, but in a way that makes your skin crawl. The way someone says your name. The exact way sunlight falls through the classroom window at 3:47 PM. A voice echoing in your head like a song you can almost remember.[/p][p]Kaito begins to notice the patterns. The quiet repetitions. The déjà vu that’s too detailed to be coincidence. And the strange way four girls at school seem to know him more deeply than they should.[/p][p]Our minds are incredible archivists. They store everything : every glance, every word, every promise. But when memories hurt too much, they’re placed in drawers marked “Do Not Open.” We forget not because we want to, but because we need to.[/p][p]Kaito’s memories are locked away like that. A summer that changed everything. Friends he loved and lost. A promise that still echoes, even now.[/p]

[h1]Hello Steam community:[/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45688190/317cec18272a7f3ddd1ab63738cecdab1825642d.gif"][/img][/p][p]
We're thrilled to finally introduce [i]Re:Call[/i]. This visual novel has been quietly taking shape for a long time, and it's time to share its world with you: a story about memory, identity, and the invisible ties that bind us, even when everything else fades.
 [/p][h3][b]About the Game[/b][/h3][p] Kaito Nakamura’s life seems ordinary at first glance. But something isn't right. Faces he can't place feel too familiar. Words echo in his mind with no clear origin. As past and present blur, he finds himself caught between what was forgotten and what refuses to be lost.  
[/p][h3][b]What to Expect[/b][/h3][p]: A deeply emotional story exploring memory, identity, and lost connections  [/p][p]: Dreamlike visuals in a nostalgic anime art style  [/p][p]: Branching narrative shaped by your choices  [/p][p]: Original soundtrack crafted to stir feeling and memory  
[/p][h3][b]Early Access[/b][/h3][p]The first part will be available soon. It sets the tone for the mystery ahead, beginning with a strange event at the Summer Shrine, a place whispered to be tied to forgotten promises.
[/p][h3][b]Add to Wishlist[/b][/h3][p] If you’re drawn to visual novels that linger in your thoughts long after the screen fades to black, stories that explore what we remember: and what we forget: then we hope [i]Re:Call[/i] finds a place on your wishlist. [/p]
